## Load data
```{r}
load("../Data/16S.Rdata")
load("../Data/RNA_salmon_imported.Rdata")
load("../Data/liver_dds.Rdata")
load("../Data/ileum_dds.Rdata")

taxa <- tax_table(phylo_all@tax_table) %>% as.matrix() %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column(var = "id")

taxa <- taxa %>% mutate(ASV = str_c("asv_", 1:nrow(taxa)),
                        Kingdom = str_replace_na(Kingdom,""), Kingdom = str_replace(Kingdom,"d__","k_"),
                        Phylum = str_replace_na(Phylum,""), Phylum = str_c("p_",Phylum),
                        Class = str_replace_na(Class,""), Class = str_c("c_",Class),
                        Order = str_replace_na(Order,""), Order = str_c("o_",Order),
                        Family = str_replace_na(Family,""), Family = str_c("f_",Family),
                        Genus = str_replace_na(Genus,""), Genus = str_c("g_",Genus),
                        Species = str_replace_na(Species,""), Species = str_c("s_",Species)) %>% 
# create long name for unclassified
  mutate(Class_l = case_when(Class == "c_" ~ str_c(Phylum, Class, sep = ";"),
                             TRUE ~ Class),
         Order_l = case_when(Order == "o_" ~ str_c(Class_l, Order, sep = ";"),
                             str_detect(Order, "uncultured") ~ str_c(Class_l, Order, sep = ";"),
                             TRUE ~ Order),
         Family_l = case_when(Family == "f_" ~ str_c(Order_l, Family, sep = ";"),
                              str_detect(Family, "uncultured") ~ str_c(Order_l, Family, sep = ";"),
                              TRUE ~ Family),
         Genus_l = case_when(Genus == "g_" ~ str_c(Family_l, Genus, sep = ";"),
                             str_detect(Genus, "uncultured|unidentified") ~ str_c(Family_l, Genus, sep = ";"),
                             TRUE ~ Genus),
         Species_l = case_when(Species == "s_" ~ str_c(Genus_l, Species, sep = ";"),
                               str_detect(Species, "uncultured|metagenome|unidentified") ~ str_c(Genus_l, Species, sep = ";"),
                               str_detect(Species, "Clostridium_sp|Clostridiales_bacterium") ~ str_c(Genus_l, Species, sep = ";"),
                               TRUE ~ Species))

meta_16S <- meta
out <- "../Result/Integration/"
if (!dir.exists(out)) {
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

## Sample match
```{r}
subject_id_fecal <- meta_16S |> filter(Week == "Week 12", Treatment == "Diwater") |> 
  pull(SubjectID)

subject_id_liver <- liverMD$SubjectID
subject_id_ileum <- ileumMD$SubjectID

g <- ggvenn(list("Feces" = subject_id_fecal, "Liver" = subject_id_liver, "Ileum" = subject_id_ileum), 
           set_name_size = 5, text_size = 5, show_percentage = F) + 
  labs(title="Sample from multi body sites")
ggsave(file = paste0(out,"Matched_samples.pdf"),
       plot = g, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "pdf")

```

## Liver
###  Extract data from selected subjects
```{r}
meta_fl <- meta_16S |> filter(Week == "Week 12", Treatment == "Diwater") |> 
  filter(SubjectID %in% intersect(subject_id_fecal, subject_id_liver))
liverMD_f <- liverMD |> filter(SubjectID %in% intersect(subject_id_fecal, subject_id_liver))

## genus table
phylo_fl <- prune_samples(meta_fl$SampleID, phylo_rf)
phylo_fl_g <- tax_glom(phylo_fl, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ft <- phylo_fl_g@otu_table@.Data
ft <- ft[rowSums(ft)>0,]
ft <- t(ft) |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column(var = "SampleID") |> 
  left_join(meta_fl |> dplyr::select(SampleID, SubjectID), by = "SampleID") |> 
  dplyr::select(-SampleID) |> arrange(SubjectID) |> column_to_rownames(var = "SubjectID") 
## filter 20% prevalence and CLR normalization
genus_keep <- colMeans(ft > 0) >= 0.2
ft_clr <- clr(ft + 1) |> as.matrix()
genus <- ft_clr[, genus_keep]

## gene exprission
dds <- liver_dds[,liverMD_f$TubeID]
gene_keep <- rowMeans(counts(dds)>=10)>=0.2
dds <- dds[gene_keep,]
design(dds) <- ~ 1
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
rna_vst <- assay(vsd)
rna <- rna_vst[, liverMD_f$TubeID] |> t() |> 
  as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column(var = "TubeID") |> 
  right_join(liverMD_f |> dplyr::select(TubeID, SubjectID), by = "TubeID") |> 
  dplyr::select(-TubeID) |> arrange(SubjectID) |> column_to_rownames(var = "SubjectID") |> 
  as.matrix()
vars <- apply(rna,2,var)
vars <- sort(vars[is.finite(vars)&vars>1e-8],decreasing=TRUE)

## align sample order
samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(genus),rownames(rna)))
genus <- genus[samples, , drop = FALSE]
rna   <- rna[samples, , drop = FALSE]

## create stratum of facility and Sex
wmeta <- meta_fl |> dplyr::select(SubjectID, FamilyID, Facility, Sex)
rownames(wmeta) <- NULL
wmeta$Stratum <- interaction(wmeta$Facility,wmeta$Sex,drop=TRUE)

## keep 1000 top variance genes
common_genes <- head(names(vars), 1000)
X = genus
Y <- rna[,common_genes,drop=FALSE]

out <- '../Result/Integration/Liver/'
if (!dir.exists(out)) {
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

### sPLS
```{r}
set.seed(1)
fit <- mixOmics::spls(X, Y,ncomp = 2,
                       keepX = 15, keepY= 30,
                       mode='canonical',scale=TRUE)

#fit <- full$M1$fit

### scores
scores <- tibble::tibble(
  SubjectID = rownames(fit$variates$X),
  X_comp1 = fit$variates$X[, 1],
  X_comp2 = fit$variates$X[, 2],
  Y_comp1 = fit$variates$Y[, 1],
  Y_comp2 = fit$variates$Y[, 2],) |>
  dplyr::left_join(wmeta,by = "SubjectID")

r1 <- cor(scores$X_comp1, scores$Y_comp1)
r2 <- cor(scores$X_comp2, scores$Y_comp2)

p1 <- ggplot(scores, aes(X_comp1, X_comp2)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = Facility, shape = Sex),size = 3) +
      scale_color_manual(values = col_facility) + 
    labs(x = "Microbiome comp1", 
       y = "Microbiome comp2") + theme_classic() + theme_all

p2 <- ggplot(scores, aes(Y_comp1, Y_comp2)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = Facility, shape = Sex),size = 3) +
      scale_color_manual(values = col_facility) + 
    labs(x = "Transcriptome comp1", 
       y = "Transcriptome comp2") + theme_classic() + theme_all

p3 <- ggplot(scores, aes(X_comp1, Y_comp1)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE,color = "grey45",linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Facility, shape = Sex),size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = sprintf("r = %.2f", r1), 
           hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_facility) +
  labs(x = "Microbiome latent score 1", 
       y = "Transcriptome latent score 1") + theme_classic() + 
  theme_all

save_fixed_panels(plots = list(p1, p2, p3), ncol = 3, shared_legend = TRUE,
                  filename = paste0(out, "lantent_score.pdf"))

#### heatmaps
taxa_id <- rownames(mixOmics::selectVar(fit, comp = 1)$X$value)
genes_id <- rownames(mixOmics::selectVar(fit, comp = 1)$Y$value)

taxa_anno <- taxa |> filter(id %in% taxa_id) |> 
  mutate(taxa_string = case_when(str_detect(Genus_l, "ASF|GCA|Incertae_Sedis") ~ str_c(Family,";",Genus_l),
                                 TRUE ~ Genus_l))

gene_anno <- genelist |> filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% genes_id) |> 
  dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, mgi_symbol) |> unique()

Xmat <- X[, taxa_id, drop = FALSE] |> 
  t() |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column(var = "id") |> 
  left_join(taxa_anno |> dplyr::select(id, taxa_string), by = "id") |> 
  dplyr::select(-id) |> column_to_rownames(var = "taxa_string") |> 
  as.matrix()

Xz <- t(scale(t(Xmat)))

Ymat <- Y[, genes_id, drop = FALSE] |> 
  t() |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column(var = "ensembl_gene_id") |> 
  left_join(gene_anno, by = "ensembl_gene_id") |> 
  dplyr::select(-ensembl_gene_id) |> column_to_rownames(var = "mgi_symbol") |> 
  as.matrix()

Yz <- t(scale(t(Ymat)))

ord <- order(wmeta$Facility, wmeta$Sex)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Facility = wmeta$Facility[ord],
  Sex = wmeta$Sex[ord],
  col = list(Facility = col_facility, Sex = col_sex)
)

ht1 <- Heatmap(
  Xz[, ord, drop = FALSE],
  name = "Genus Zscore",
  width = ncol(Xz) * unit(8, "mm"), 
  height = nrow(Xz) * unit(4, "mm"),
  top_annotation = ha,
  column_split = wmeta$Facility[ord],
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_title = "Microbiome",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(Xz), gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2),
    c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))
)

ht2 <- Heatmap(
  Yz[, ord, drop = FALSE],
  name = "RNA Zscore",
  width = ncol(Yz) * unit(8, "mm"), 
  height = nrow(Yz) * unit(4, "mm"),
  #top_annotation = ha,
  column_split = wmeta$Facility[ord],
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_column_names = FALSE,
  row_title = "Transcriptome",
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(Yz), gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2),
    c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))
)
p1 <- draw(ht1 %v% ht2)
pdf(file = paste0(out,"multiomics_heatmap.pdf"), bg = "white",
    width = ComplexHeatmap:::width(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, 
    height = ComplexHeatmap:::height(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, useDingbats = F)
draw(p1)
dev.off()

#### genus gene correlation
Xcor <- X[, taxa_id, drop = FALSE] 

Ycor <- Y[, genes_id, drop = FALSE] 
  
res <- Hmisc::rcorr(
  as.matrix(cbind(Xcor, Ycor)),
  type = "pearson"
)

R <- res$r[taxa_id, genes_id, drop = FALSE]
P <- res$P[taxa_id, genes_id, drop = FALSE]
Q <- matrix(
  p.adjust(as.vector(P), method = "BH"),
  nrow = nrow(P),
  ncol = ncol(P),
  dimnames = dimnames(P)
)
sig <- matrix(
  "",
  nrow = nrow(Q),
  ncol = ncol(Q),
  dimnames = dimnames(Q)
)
sig[Q < 0.05]  <- "*"
sig[Q < 0.01]  <- "**"
sig[Q < 0.001] <- "***"

gene_symbol <- gene_anno$mgi_symbol[match(colnames(R), gene_anno$ensembl_gene_id)]
colnames(R) <- colnames(P) <- colnames(Q) <- colnames(sig) <- gene_symbol

taxa_name <- taxa_anno$taxa_string[match(rownames(R), taxa_anno$id)]
rownames(R) <- rownames(P) <- rownames(Q) <- rownames(sig) <- taxa_name

ht <- Heatmap(
  R,
  name = "Pearson r",
  col = circlize::colorRamp2(
    c(-1, 0, 1), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
  width = ncol(R) * unit(4, "mm"), 
  height = nrow(R) * unit(4, "mm"),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_columns = TRUE,
  row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  row_names_max_width = max_text_width(rownames(R), gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)),
  column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  column_title = "RNA genes",
  row_title = "Genus",
  cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
    grid::grid.text(
      sig[i, j],
      x = x,
      y = y,
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9)
    )}
)

p1 <- draw(ht)
pdf(file = paste0(out,"genus_gene_cor.pdf"), bg = "white",
    width = ComplexHeatmap:::width(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, 
    height = ComplexHeatmap:::height(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, useDingbats = F)
draw(p1)
dev.off()

```


## Ileum
###  Extract data from selected subjects
```{r}
meta_fi <- meta_16S |> filter(Week == "Week 12", Treatment == "Diwater") |> 
  filter(SubjectID %in% intersect(subject_id_fecal, subject_id_ileum))
ileumMD_f <- ileumMD |> filter(SubjectID %in% intersect(subject_id_fecal, subject_id_ileum))

## genus table
phylo_fi <- prune_samples(meta_fi$SampleID, phylo_rf)
phylo_fi_g <- tax_glom(phylo_fi, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
ft <- phylo_fi_g@otu_table@.Data
ft <- ft[rowSums(ft)>0,]
ft <- t(ft) |> as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column(var = "SampleID") |> 
  left_join(meta_fi |> dplyr::select(SampleID, SubjectID), by = "SampleID") |> 
  dplyr::select(-SampleID) |> arrange(SubjectID) |> column_to_rownames(var = "SubjectID") 
## filter 20% prevalence and CLR normalization
genus_keep <- colMeans(ft > 0) >= 0.2
ft_clr <- clr(ft + 1) |> as.matrix()
genus <- ft_clr[, genus_keep]

## gene exprission
dds <- ileum_dds[,ileumMD_f$TubeID]
gene_keep <- rowMeans(counts(dds)>=10)>=0.2
dds <- dds[gene_keep,]
design(dds) <- ~ 1
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)
rna_vst <- assay(vsd)
rna <- rna_vst[, ileumMD_f$TubeID] |> t() |> 
  as.data.frame() |> rownames_to_column(var = "TubeID") |> 
  right_join(ileumMD_f |> dplyr::select(TubeID, SubjectID), by = "TubeID") |> 
  dplyr::select(-TubeID) |> arrange(SubjectID) |> column_to_rownames(var = "SubjectID") |> 
  as.matrix()

vars <- apply(rna,2,var)
vars <- sort(vars[is.finite(vars)&vars>1e-8],decreasing=TRUE)

## align sample order
samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(rownames(genus),rownames(rna)))
genus <- genus[samples, , drop = FALSE]
rna   <- rna[samples, , drop = FALSE]

wmeta <- meta_fi |> dplyr::select(SubjectID, FamilyID, Facility, Sex)
rownames(wmeta) <- NULL

wmeta$Stratum <- interaction(wmeta$Facility,wmeta$Sex,drop=TRUE)

# keep 1000 top variance genes
common_genes <- head(names(vars), 1000)
X = genus
Yall = rna
Y <- Yall[,common_genes,drop=FALSE]

out <- '../Result/Integration/Ileum/'
if (!dir.exists(out)) {
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

### sPLS
```{r}
set.seed(1)

### scores

  Y_comp1 = fit$variates$Y[, 1],
  Y_comp2 = fit$variates$Y[, 2],) |>
  dplyr::left_join(wmeta,by = "SubjectID")

r1 <- cor(scores$X_comp1, scores$Y_comp1)
r2 <- cor(scores$X_comp2, scores$Y_comp2)

p1 <- ggplot(scores, aes(X_comp1, X_comp2)) + 
    geom_point(aes(color = Facility, shape = Sex),size = 3) +

  geom_point(aes(color = Facility, shape = Sex),size = 3) +

    )}
)

p1 <- draw(ht)
pdf(file = paste0(out,"genus_gene_cor.pdf"), bg = "white",
    width = ComplexHeatmap:::width(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, 
    height = ComplexHeatmap:::height(p1) %>% as.numeric()/25.4, useDingbats = F)
draw(p1)
dev.off()
```
